name: Seek
desc:
Seek is an exciting twist on classic hide-and-seek!

😎 AS HIDER: Outsmart the seekers and stay hidden until the timer runs out! Use clever tactics and blend in to avoid being caught.
🔍 AS SEEKER: Team up to find the lone hider before the clock runs out! The timer speeds up, so think fast and act faster!

💰 Collect coins to unlock awesome abilities and stylish cosmetics!
✨ Premium players enjoy exclusive perks and faster rewards!
